messages:
jess: Kicking off handoff for private-vpc build 1.6.3-delta. Need final signer + checksum verification before transit to customer mirror.

mike: Uploaded signed-submanifest.json to s3://redwood-release/private/1.6.3/delta and rotated the cosign key. checksum file at s3://redwood-release/private/1.6.3/checksums.txt

sarah: Thanks — can you paste the top-level manifest hash here? Ops needs to validate with their KMS during escort.

mike: top-level manifest sha256:```
sha256: 4f7a3b2c9d8e0a6b1f2c3d4e5f67890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890ab
```

jess: Confirming. Also we need to pin the installer image tag in the manifest to v1.6.3-20260319-rc2 to avoid any delta rewrite during the transport step.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled 2026-03-21T18:00Z (30m). Canary nodes: eu-west-1a. Auto-abort if checksum mismatch or unreachable mirror. Rollback target: v1.6.2.

oncall-bot: oncall-bot: Alerting policy enabled for transport failures. Pager Duty: @oncall on rotation.

sarah: Quick checklist: cosign signature present, submanifest hash matches top-level, image tags pinned, KMS key thumbprint matches customer inventory, release notes attached.

mike: All set except KMS thumbprint confirmation. @eng-release-coordinator can you run remote attest against customer KMS endpoint? I don't have direct access.

eng-release-coordinator: Running attest now against kms://customer-vpc/kms-key-1. Will post results in 5m. If mismatch we regenerate signer and reissue signed-submanifest.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Attest job started (job id: 86f4b).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Attest job finished. KMS thumbprint SHA1:d3:2f:9b:4a:11:7c:aa:ee:44:b2:9d:3c:5e:1f:2a:bb:cc:dd matches customer's inventory file. Proceeding with canary.

jess: Great. Sending release notes and cutover window to customer now. Note: rollback plan pinned to v1.6.2 and transport fallback to offline mirror A if transit fails.

sarah: Also add note about config flag installer.strict_verify=true so customer's infra runs strict verification on apply.

mike: Uploaded final release_notes_v1.6.3.md and pushed manifest to courier. Link: https://internal/redwood/releases/1.6.3/notes

jess: I'll stay on the channel during the canary window, watching deploy-bot and ops logs. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started at 2026-03-21T18:00Z. Streaming logs to /var/logs/release/1.6.3/canary.log

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary complete at 2026-03-21T18:27Z (+27m). No checksum mismatches, KMS attest OK, transport latency within SLO. No rollbacks triggered. Scheduling long-tail rollout over next 8h.

jess: :tada: Great work everyone. I'll file the final handoff email and close out post-release checklist after the long-tail completes.

sarah: Leaving note for QA: if any customer-side verification failures appear, revert to v1.6.2 immediately and open a severity-2 incident.

mike: Acknowledged. Closing my end of the packaging task.

jess: Closing thread after final handoff email; will ping if anything unexpected shows up.
